name: Retract The Bridge
status: native implementation with official rules review; GEMP parity unavailable

officialSources.purpose: Official card image; card text also retained in public/catalog/cards.json. Own deploy phase, use Force equal to the number of interior Death Star sites to rearrange them; cards stay with their sites. Alternative: cancel On The Edge.
officialSources.verification: Catalog card text inspected; direct web image retrieval was unavailable during this review.

officialSources.purpose: Rearranged Death Star sites must retain a legal location layout, including Docking Bay 327 at an end. Laser Gates may be relocated between interior Death Star sites.
Central Core card text grants free Retract The Bridge while Dark controls the site. Its text provides no immunity from Interrupt cancellation.
officialSources.verification: Catalog text and unchanged pinned Card1_283 implementation inspected.

reference.finding: No Card2_138 implementation exists in the pinned reference source. References to the title in Central Core and cancellation cards do not implement Retract The Bridge itself.
reference.claim: Native tests and official rules review are not executed GEMP conformance evidence.

nativeScope: Own deploy phase rearrangement with Force cost fixed at initiation.
Central Core free play retained when control or the source changes after initiation.
Sequential durable site ordering with Docking Bay 327 restricted to legal endpoints.
Cards, attachments, captives and markers retain their physical site IDs as location order changes.
On The Edge cancellation binds the original pending action and response window before destiny resolves.
Skywalker and Sense can cancel the Interrupt; free Core play does not grant cancellation immunity.
Serialized physical references, layout snapshots, cost receipts and validators reject stale sources, incomplete target lists and unsupported free prices.
